title: Aajay
desc: Ajay, a kabaddi player, hides Padma from Veerabhadra, a gangster who wants to force her into marrying him. Soon, the two fall in love.

title: Kshetrapati
desc: After his father's suicide, Basava embarks on a revolutionary journey in search of justice.

title: Lakshmi Mahalakshmi
desc: Chandrappa believes that his daughter, Lakshmi, brings good luck and his second daughter, Anita, brings bad luck.

title: Maurya
desc: Manu, a kick-boxer must train and win an upcoming tournament to fulfill his mother's wishes and to become the best in the world.

title: Thangigagi
desc: Veerabhadra, who loves his sister very much, gets her married to a nice man. However, when Veerabhadra's close friend is killed, he decides to wipe out anti-social elements in the city.
